# qrcode-generator (retired)

`deploy/vpn/site/vendor/qrcode.js` was `dist/qrcode.js` of qrcode-generator 2.0.4
(Kazuhiko Arase, MIT, https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator), copied verbatim from
the npm tarball (SHA-256 `79ec86f82856005b1c887905cfccfcfbec3821ca61c7fd5a952faa5f778f791c`).
It drew the QR code of the AmneziaVPN invite page, which was removed on 2026-10-08 together with
the invite tool (`deploy/vpn`). `LICENSE-HEADER` is the file's license notice. The page's client
config and `vpn://` format followed AmneziaVPN (GPL-3.0) and AmneziaWG for iOS (MIT); their sources
were consulted, no code was copied.
